title: Azzy Battles the Darkness
short_description: Unleash elemental powers through your bionic arm in a story-driven 3D action-platformer inspired by the PS2 era.
description:
Unleash elemental powers through your bionic arm in a story-driven 3D action-platformer inspired by the PS2 era. Explore 5 sprawling elemental realms, master explosive mobility upgrades, battle chaotic bosses, and search for your missing father before the Darkness consumes everything.

When his father vanishes and an ancient Darkness emerges, a young Felko named Azzy sets out across five elemental villages, meeting a fully voiced cast, collecting Dark Crystals to upgrade his bionic arm, and facing five Elemental Bosses that each demand a different strategy.
